title: 04 · Browser cascade: five heroes, one index
strengths: An editorial idea executed exactly: five windows on a fixed step so each one behind shows only its address bar and navigation, which is enough to read five different systems, and the front one shows its whole hero
The numbered index with hairline connectors and one orange '05' is restrained typography doing the whole job; two type sizes, one accent
Window chrome stays quiet (grey dots, a centred URL pill) so the pages inside lead
slop_signals: A faint 12-column grid drawn across the whole page background is decoration (a blueprint-grid tic)
The hairlines from the index end at the window's left edge, but 'Kumo Kōbō' and 'Plumpot' sit behind Isobath's shadow so their lines vanish into the stack
fixes: Remove the background column grid, or keep only the gutter lines nearest the index
End each connector 8 px before its window and give the index rows the same 104 px rhythm as the windows so the lines read as one system

references.what: Stacked sheets showing only each site's top strip; the fan reads as many sites at once, the device our stack borrows
A numbered editorial index with a hairline between entries; the same index language as our left column
A browser frame kept flat and quiet so the content inside leads
A flat row of site cards with a label under each; the plainer alternative to a cascade
